sources.title: UniVoice: Unifying Autoregressive ASR and Flow-Matching based TTS
sources.snippet: In this work, we present UniVoice, a unified LLM framework through continuous representations that seamlessly integrates speech recognition and synthesis within a single model. Our approach combines the strengths of autoregressive modeling for speech recognition with flow matching for high-quality generation.
